landing.hero_title: A path of their own for every learner
landing.hero_text: NeuroLearn picks the next topic from a knowledge graph and a student model: new topics open once their prerequisites are mastered.
landing.feature_graph_text: A course holds sections and topics; prerequisites on a section are inherited by its topics.
landing.feature_model_text: Every answer updates the mastery probability P(L) from BKT, the item difficulty and the prerequisites.
landing.feature_path_text: Topics needing review come first, then the ones in progress and the open ones — each with its reason.
